_comment: Documents the shapes the RFP screens render. NOT loaded at runtime — the mocks inline
their data as JS, per the house pattern. This file exists so a reader can see the intended
field set without reading the mock's script block.
An RFP is a platform Project with projectType=rfp. projectType, visibility, status and
lifecycle below are REAL platform vocabularies, verified against @zerobias-com/platform-sdk
on 2026-08-18 — not invented for the mock.
NO MONEY. The Ledger owns pricing; budget was deliberately dropped from the model. There is
no budget or price field here on purpose.

platformVocabularies._note: ProjectStatus cannot express open-for-bidding vs bidding-closed vs awarded — all three are Active. That gap is why the bidding lifecycle is proposed as activities on a board on the RFP project. Vocabulary UNCONFIRMED; the mocks show only Open and Closing soon.

rfp.name: FedRAMP Moderate — continuous monitoring support
rfp.description: Ongoing ConMon, monthly POA&M maintenance and annual assessment support for a SaaS platform.
rfp._visibilityNote: visibility=Private is what makes an RfpInvitation necessary. Private RFPs are BACKBURNERED until the rest of the arc exists (Clark, 2026-08-18).

_comment: The R5 bid gate. A vendor cannot bid until THEIR OWN pre-req pairs are accepted.
This is one entangled PAIR per requirement per candidate — never one demand task with N
suppliers (D-59). The RFP's requirement set is a TEMPLATE authored once; candidacy
INSTANTIATES it per candidate. So nothing another vendor submits can satisfy yours.
Link type is live on prod: tasksatisfiestask 182d7fd6-6f3e-11f1-866f-7f0be032d30e,
MVP CAVEAT (Parks): the live substrate is soft / one-legged today — close = done, no
mirror — until Project-as-Reactor (task-98) lands. The mocks show the full two-legged
shape deliberately. Mock the full shape, build against the soft one.
candidatePrerequisite.label: Professional liability insurance

demand._leg: buyer side — a task on the RFP
demand.name: Is the seller insured to our threshold?

supply._leg: vendor side — a task on the vendor's engagement
supply.name: Upload certificate of insurance

_states.done: buyer accepted — the pair is satisfied
_states.wait: evidence submitted, awaiting the buyer's acceptance

derivedEligibility._comment: DERIVED, never stored — same discipline as projects-requirements.html:453. A vendor is eligible only when every one of their own pairs for that RFP is accepted.
derivedEligibility.rule: all pairs accepted -> Eligible · some -> Pre-reqs outstanding · none -> Not started
